`tree.7z` and `tree.rar` are test fixtures from compress-tools 0.16.1:
https://github.com/OSSystems/compress-tools-rs/tree/v0.16.1/tests/fixtures

Copyright O.S. Systems Software LTDA. Used under the MIT license included here.
Other archive fixtures are generated by tests from synthetic content.

`locked.zip` is synthetic AES-256 ZIP test data generated for this project using
zip 2.4.2. It contains `folder/secret.txt` with `archive cat smoke content\n`;
the test password is `correct`. It is used by `archive_smoke.py`.
